add.title: Sit-to-stand lift (stand-assist lift)
add.flag: Medicaid clients: any lift transfer is an advanced personal care task a nurse must certify. CC does not offer it, so a Medicaid client who needs a lift is flagged to the office, not matched. Private pay: only when the care plan says so.
add.notes: Only use a sit-to-stand lift when the client's care plan says so and after the office has trained you on that client's lift. Follow the maker's instructions for that model, and check the straps, the sling and the brakes every time before you start. The client must be able to bear some weight on their legs and hold on with their hands. If they cannot, or seem weaker than usual, stop and call the office.
add.review_note: Each video shows one brand; caregivers still learn the client's actual lift from the office. The Joerns and Arjo videos are product demos with no narration about who is NOT a candidate; the Open RN video covers that. Backup: Invacare 'Battery Powered Stand-Up Lifts' (youtube.com/watch?v=n1IaI5h0pNA).
